text:
debrief db-021
1) t-h-e a-c-t-o-r a-t-t-e-m-p-t-e-d l-o-g-i-n-s a-g-a-i-n-s-t l-o-y-a-l-t-y a-c-c-o-u-n-t-s a-n-d c-h-e-c-k-e-d g-i-f-t c-a-r-d b-a-l-a-n-c-e-s, l-e-f-t r-e-c-o-r-d-s o-f a-u-t-o-m-a-t-e-d s-i-g-n-i-n-g i-n-s t-h-e l-o-g-s, a-n-d s-k-i-p-p-e-d t-h-e v-e-r-i-f-i-c-a-t-i-o-n s-t-e-p f-o-r e-v-e-r-y t-r-y.

2) t-h-e a-c-t-o-r t-a-k-e-o-v-e-r-s t-h-e s-t-o-l-e-n a-c-c-o-u-n-t-s b-y b-y-p-a-s-s-i-n-g t-w-o f-a-c-t-o-r c-h-e-c-k-s, d-e-l-e-t-e-d o-l-d s-e-s-s-i-o-n d-a-t-a a-n-d s-w-o-r-e i-n w-i-t-h n-e-w c-o-o-k-i-e-s, a-n-d s-k-i-p-p-e-d t-h-e s-t-a-n-d-a-r-d s-e-c-u-r-i-t-y v-e-r-i-f-i-c-a-t-i-o-n.

3) t-h-e a-c-t-o-r d-r-a-w-d-o-w-n g-i-f-t c-a-r-d v-a-l-u-e-s i-n-t-o c-a-s-h o-r g-o-o-d-s u-s-i-n-g t-h-e c-o-m-p-r-o-m-i-s-e-d p-r-o-f-i-l-e-s, f-o-u-n-d t-h-e d-r-a-w-d-o-w-n h-i-s-t-o-r-y i-n s-y-s-t-e-m l-o-g-s, a-n-d s-k-i-p-p-e-d t-h-e m-a-n-u-a-l r-e-v-i-e-w o-f l-a-r-g-e c-h-e-c-k-o-u-t-s.

4) t-h-e a-c-t-o-r b-u-r-i-e-d m-a-l-i-c-i-o-u-s p-u-r-c-h-a-s-e-s a-m-o-n-g l-e-g-i-t-i-m-a-t-e o-r-d-e-r-s a-n-d l-o-w e-r-t-y l-e-v-e-l-s a-c-t-i-v-i-t-y, l-e-f-t b-e-h-i-n-d a m-i-x-e-d t-r-a-n-s-a-c-t-i-o-n h-i-s-t-o-r-y f-o-r i-n-s-p-e-c-t-i-o-n, a-n-d s-k-i-p-p-e-d t-h-e i-d-e-n-t-i-f-i-c-a-t-i-o-n o-f u-n-u-s-u-a-l p-a-t-t-e-r-n-s.

5) t-h-e a-c-t-o-r u-s-e-d f-r-e-q-u-e-n-c-y a-n-d a-m-o-u-n-t v-a-r-i-a-t-i-o-n t-o m-i-m-i-c n-o-r-m-a-l s-h-o-p-p-i-n-g b-e-h-a-v-i-o-r, l-e-f-t t-r-a-c-e-s o-f d-i-s-t-r-i-b-u-t-e-d s-m-a-l-l b-u-y-s a-c-r-o-s-s m-u-l-t-i-p-l-e c-a-t-e-g-o-r-i-e-s, a-n-d s-k-i-p-p-e-d t-h-e b-e-h-a-v-i-o-r-a-l m-o-n-i-t-o-r-i-n-g t-h-a-t w-o-u-l-d f-l-a-g s-u-c-h p-a-t-t-e-r-n-s.
